_comment: Tier-2 trigger evals for core-fe: changed file → skill(s) skill-triggers.md must surface. Add a case when wiring a new file-pattern route.

cases.why: Route marker files must run the fe-route-island skill.
Org guard chains and gatewayFromManifest live in routeTree.
Resource manifests follow the fe-resource-crud skill.
Forms with API mutations need error-mapping checklist.
Env schema changes require platform hygiene and fe-env-schema-add.
Page components need composition + colocated tests.
Vendored shadcn primitives route through the shadcn skill.
TanStack Query hooks must follow react-best-practices.
E2E specs require stable data-testid conventions.
Design tokens and Tailwind entry must stay semantic.
Env template changes must stay documented and secret-free.
Constants files hold keys/IDs/defaults and route to fe-i18n-constants.
The PWA manifest source of truth routes to fe-pwa-manifest.
Screenshot-baseline spec edits follow the fe-visual-regression skill (baseline discipline, snapshot matrix).
